item.title: Filter light needed at this junction, 6th October
item.description:
Please time in a filter light in for people coming out of Station Road. This is the only road on this junction that is a single lane of traffic, every other road has separate turning lanes, but this road is constantly filled with traffic as people trying to turn right get held up and block the junction. When Leesons Hill was closed for weeks recently, it really highlighted that traffic would flow perfectly well if traffic was allowed to move uninterrupted for a sequence. Please, factor in a sequence where all other traffic is held and allow flow from Station Road. Everything would move so much easier.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Sevenoaks Way, Poverest, Greater London

When the lights go out at 1am you could quite easily brake your ankle and fall down. The cars crossing over this is keeping the residents awake at night.
